residual.wall: Nuke Merge is A+B(1-a) on pixel buffers. Gasper is one closed silhouette. Calling the five-column compiler a compositor is a category error: there is no plate B. Dual: composite = one hull. Second dual: composition-frame = composition-graph.

coordinateSpaces: Graph G=(N,E). Socket kinds: contour512, lattice360/672, relief25x40, scalar, phase φ, pose (VEC-501 bindings), take τ∈[0,T], shade coeffs. Content px on the hull. Screen-space composition frame (GasperCompositionContract). No image buffer. No exec token. No plate B.
physicalLaw: A compositor operates on independent image buffers. Nuke Merge default over is A + B(1-a) on premultiplied RGBA. Fusion/Natron are the same family. No B ⇒ no Merge.

Blender keeps three graphs because they operate on three substances: Geometry Nodes (mesh/fields), Shader Nodes (BSDF at a point), Compositor (rendered pixels). Unreal keeps Event / Anim / Material / Control Rig for the same reason. Gasper already has Machine (flags+pose mixer), Cook (fields), Painter (shade + sole d).
Cavalry: generators → effectors → render. They refuse to be a compositor and hand alpha to AE. Gasper is Cavalry, not AE.

Harmony Composite node: several images → one image. Cutter: matte drawing hides a drawing. Peg: transform. Attribute Controller: insert an offset into the attribute's final values so rig and controller both adjust (non-destructive).

VEC-501 ResolvedPoseCompositor composites semantic bindings (numbers) in a fixed order. It is a mixer of offsets, not an image tree. Single authority. Compatibility adapters may not resolve independently.
Fields compile. Mute = out=in on the incoming buffer. Fan-out legal. Fan-in is one source or Join=Σ on the same lock or Offset. Never concatenate. Never remesh. Cycles illegal.
Circle (scalar/phase/pose/take) may feed diamond (contour/lattice/relief). Diamond may not feed circle without Reduce. Shade feeds shade only. take→pose is Backwards. take→contour is illegal.
artisticLaw: One organism on the monitor. The graph is the instrument. The PIP is him.
Cards OFFSET. They do not overwrite. Couple lerp(user, law, mix) is already Harmony Attribute Controller. Living is additive. Character-state is the only overwrite and is final authority.
Pearl is painter's algorithm on inset contours of the same 512. Not A-over-B of independent plates. Vesicle-stack already named foam-on-black = vesicles-in-gel.
GasperCompositionContract keeps the word composition for shot framing (safe margin, occupy, face overlap). Do not spend it on a graph.
A card without a typed port that can reject is a poster. socketsCompatible currently cannot reject. That is chrome.
Do not name the Nodes page a compositor. Do not add a sixth column. Do not catalog the ghost compositor as Merge.
